panels.narrative: The Manhattan Monolith hummed with the low-frequency vibration of a world-class server room, a sterile resonance that Elias Thorne had long mistaken for the sound of power.
From the 88th Floor, the city below was merely a sprawling data visualization, a grid of flickering lights representing millions of sub-routines running in a loop.
Elias stood against the floor-to-ceiling glass, his reflection a thin, translucent ghost superimposed over the dawn.
